nodes.label: Phone map mode bootstrap (FEAR_MOBILE token)
nodes.rationale: Token travels as URL fragment so it never reaches a server or logs, and is removed from the address once read; decided before sim-client.js loads.

nodes.label: Area Classification Layer
nodes.rationale: Membership is never stored on features; derived geometrically from polygons so redrawing re-addresses instantly with nothing to drift out of sync.

nodes.label: Density-based (red-dot weighted) signal mode
nodes.rationale: Approach weight = count of waiting vehicles + seconds waited; deliberately no fixed phase timer.

nodes.label: dispatchIncident command
nodes.rationale: Ranks by straight-line distance, not route cost; CH query per candidate judged not worth it for rare events.

nodes.label: Vehicle emergency flag / emergencyPhase (em/ep)
nodes.rationale: Flag deliberately separate from vehicleType so non-dispatched emergency-capable vehicles get no priority.

nodes.label: Incident-preset Emergency Control UI
nodes.rationale: Self-contained cards per incident avoid inspector click friction; timer keyed to sim clock so cadence scales with fast-forward; live editable cards never rebuilt on a timer.

nodes.label: Level-of-detail Load Map By Area (AreaView)
nodes.rationale: Visibility gate rather than unloading State, so clearing is instant and undo/save untouched; whole-road inclusion.

nodes.label: Phase 3: WebSocket Streaming + Live Rendering
nodes.rationale: Hand-rolled WebSocket server with no external deps to match the project's g++ -static convention.

nodes.label: Police station jurisdiction assignment (policingStationAt)
nodes.rationale: Explicit assignment because station coverage is a decision, not a geometric fact.

nodes.label: Hard edge-transition capacity check
nodes.rationale: IDM lookahead is advisory only; a hard floor on chain-to-chain and full junction-edge transitions eliminated same-point vehicle stacking (~44,600 to ~240 overlap pairs).

nodes.label: Emergency preemption (lead-time / grace / clearing)
nodes.rationale: Reactive front-of-queue preemption was too late; replaced with route-lookahead ETA trigger (PREEMPT_LEAD_SEC 10s), grace release (PREEMPT_GRACE_SEC 5s), a 5s yellow Clearing window, own-approach forced open, only conflicting approaches forced red, and lapse for stuck vehicles.

nodes.label: Intelligent Driver Model (IDM) car-following
nodes.rationale: Tuned 'selfish' (tighter headway, higher accel) so vehicles don't wait unless they have to.

nodes.label: Junction conflict compatibility (movementsCompatible)
nodes.rationale: Conservative flow-channel approximation rather than full conflict-point geometry; opposite right turns allowed only when destination ways differ, after a chord-crossing test was found wrong.

nodes.label: Lane-commitment lookahead (desiredLaneForStep)
nodes.rationale: Looking ahead through the whole approach chain lets turning vehicles commit early, fixing artificial single-file traffic near junctions.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph (query/path/explain/section) before raw grep to keep context small; run graphify update after code changes; graph.json diffs are expected churn.
